newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: CAM sacks finance chief revamps board.
newsitem.headline: CAM sacks finance chief revamps board.

text.p: CAM International Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it had fired chief financial officer Ng Chee Tiong and revamped the board, bringing in former minister Ahmad Mattar as non-executive director.

The precision engineering company, under investigation by the Commercial Affairs Department (CAD) for alleged fraud, said it fired Ng on Wednesday and would take the necessary steps to remove him as executive directive at the next general meeting.
CAM also said in a statement that chairman Chew Chuan Seng and vice chairman Yap Bu Lim had quit the board.
Lee Kwong Loong, a director of CAM Advanced Technologies in Malaysia and CAM Manufacturing in Singapore, was appointed executive director, the statement said.
An auditor's report said Ng and Chew may have cheated and committed criminal breach of trust against the company, triggering the CAD investigation.

The white collar crime unit is seeking Ng, while Chew was charged last month with the misappropriation of Singapore $1.45 million in company funds and is out on bail, according to The Business Times newspaper.

Auditors Ernst & Young told the Finance Ministry in April that the two directors withheld information from CAM's board on the true nature of a multi-million dollar debt owed to a Malaysian subsidiary by a third party.
